name: Finger of Death
summary: Blasts a creature with negative energy for heavy Necrotic damage, raising a slain Humanoid as a Zombie.

stats.effect:
You unleash negative energy toward a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d8 + 30 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

A Humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a **{ref:creature/zombie}** (see "Monsters") that follows your verbal orders.
